meta.proposer: claude (propose-once / freeze / replay; same protocol as s6e1/s4e1/s6e2)
meta.strategy: Pool has NO shallow XGB (only depth 5-8) and NO shallow CatBoost (only 7-9); shallow LGB is covered. Inject bias-dominated depth-2/3 members of the under-represented families to decorrelate the mid/deep pool (the archetype that took the largest LLM-member weight on s6e1 & s4e1). Params within s3e7 whitelist; AUC rank-invariant so no imbalance weighting (INT-00/03).

proposals.expected: Solo AUC ~0.895-0.899 (below the mid-depth members) but lowest error-correlation; realistic shot at nonzero blend weight.
proposals.rationale: Only XGB in pool is depth 5-8 (variance-leaning). A depth-3, gamma+reg-heavy XGB is bias-dominated -> maximal decorrelation. Same archetype that won the largest LLM weight on s6e1/s4e1.

proposals.expected: Solo AUC ~0.895-0.899; shallow ordered-boosting CatBoost, differently-correlated error surface than the shallow XGB.
proposals.rationale: Pool CatBoost is only depth 7-9. A depth-3, high-l2 CatBoost adds a second bias-dominated family for decorrelation.

proposals.expected: Solo AUC ~0.892-0.897; an extreme-bias depth-2 extra-trees LGB, most decorrelated of the three.
proposals.rationale: Pool has depth-2/3 LGB, but adding extra_trees randomization + depth-2 num_leaves-4 gives a still-more-heterogeneous member; a suboptimal-but-diverse member is an asset (INT-04).
